headline: Rhombus 1.1 release introduces significant improvements for Racket developers.

items.title: Cloudflare silently injects analytics when switching nameservers
items.summary: A user discovered that after switching their nameservers to Cloudflare, a JavaScript analytics snippet was injected into their HTML-only site without explicit consent. This was revealed through the Analytics dashboard, raising concerns about privacy and transparency in DNS management.
items.why_it_matters: This incident underscores the importance of understanding third-party service integrations and their impact on privacy.

items.title: Rhombus 1.1 is now available
items.summary: The latest release of Rhombus, version 1.1, is now available, bringing a host of new features and improvements for users of the Racket programming language. This update enhances performance, expands library support, and fixes several bugs, making it a substantial upgrade for developers relying on the Racket ecosystem.

items.title: MathCode, Mathematical Coding Agent
items.summary: MathCode is a new mathematical coding agent designed to assist in solving complex mathematical problems. It leverages advanced algorithms to streamline mathematical computations and coding processes, offering a robust tool for developers working in math-intensive domains.

items.title: Agentao: A Governed Local-First Runtime for Tool-Using LLM Agents
items.summary: A new paper introduces 'Agentao', a governed runtime environment designed for local-first operation of large language model (LLM) agents. This environment allows tools to be invoked and local state modifications while minimizing risks related to over-privileged access, providing a safer framework for deploying LLM agents.

items.title: Modular Cognitive Architecture Emerges in Large Language Models
items.summary: Research suggests that large language models (LLMs) may develop modular cognitive architectures similar to the human brain. This finding could have significant implications for improving the efficiency and functionality of LLMs by aligning machine learning architectures more closely with human cognition.
